caption:
Apple pulls MiniMax's Talkie chatbot from App Store worldwide

The removal follows a media report alleging the app used sexualized content to hook young users. Talkie is a popular AI companion service developed by Chinese AI company MiniMax. The service allows users to talk or text with AI characters.

Reported by The Information.
